content:
Although CarPlay supports hundreds of apps, Apple Weather is not one of them. The good news is, starting today, The Weather Channel's Storm Radar iPhone app officially supports CarPlay.

Storm Radar is one of the growing number of weather apps on CarPlay.

The Weather Channel has been working throughout this year to make Storm Radar a top-tier app on the Apple platform.

The iPhone and iPad versions earlier added AI-driven forecasting features, followed by the launch of an Apple Watch version.

Today's new update goes a step further, adding a dedicated CarPlay app. Here's what the app looks like:

The CarPlay version of Storm Radar includes a map of your location, with the ability to switch between satellite and standard map backgrounds. Data layers include radar, cloud cover, and precipitation.

Navigation is also one of the core features of the CarPlay app. Storm Radar will display your current weather conditions, as well as weather forecasts for your estimated time of arrival and destination.

The Weather Channel added that CarPlay support includes "automatic rerouting along the route, and weather alerts that update as you drive along the way."

Today's Storm Radar app update also includes new home screen widgets, a redesigned Apple Watch app, and more features. You can see the full update notes for version 4.0.19 on the App Store.
